text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Heh... Ngh...!
choice_data_list: Alright, put the barbell down

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Focus on training during the Junior class"—
Following that principle, Daiichi Ruby steadily built up her training step by step.
choice_data_list: How was the load on those last 10 reps?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: There is no issue.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's take a quick break.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today, we did barbell squats, checking the weight she could handle based on her current muscle mass.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Eh, then that girl
won a GIII race!
choice_data_list: (Hm?)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: It's pretty amazing. It feels like our racing careers are finally kicking off for real.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I'm getting nervous... but I've got a race next month too!
I gotta keep up the pace!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, they're in the same generation as Daiichi Ruby.
It seems some of them have already gained plenty of
experience alongside their training.
choice_data_list: (I wonder... what Ruby thinks.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
choice_data_list: ...Want to try increasing the weight by 10kg all at once?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At her request, we started with weights an average adult woman could lift
and gradually increased them in minimal increments, but...
For an Umamusume, adding even more shouldn't be an issue.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: No, please make it 5 kg.
choice_data_list: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For Daiichi Ruby, who always strives for efficiency, this seemed overly cautious...
Yet, being thoroughly meticulous feels very true to her character in its own way.
choice_data_list: (Or maybe...)

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ruby, I heard your current schedule is focused
primarily on conditioning your body.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...Do you still have concerns?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her conversation with her mother back then... It could be interpreted as if she had some bodily concern in the past.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
let's resume.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Adding 5 kg.
choice_data_list: Ah... Oh!
Y... Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For now, there didn't seem to be any particular problem, but...
I decided to ask about it later just to be sure.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —I was born with a defect in the shape of my legs.
choice_data_list: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"To be precise, I would state that 'while there is an issue with the leg's shape,
it currently poses no hindrance to racing.'"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
That is why I did not specifically report it.
However, it is not something I would hide if asked.
choice_data_list: Still, the shape of the legs...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That's an area subjected to immense strain when running.
I don't think it's a minor issue that can be solved so easily, but..."
choice_data_list: Are you sure you're okay?
Are you really going to be fine?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Your concerns are completely justified.
However, my parents...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...Thanks to the devoted support of my parents
and those around me, I'm doing well, as you can see."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For an instant, I thought her expression clouded over, but... there's definitely no issue with her running right now.
She must have worked incredibly hard.
choice_data_list: You said it was from birth, but...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It seems from the moment of birth,
it was declared they would likely never run.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "However, for my sake, as I yearned to run, my parents used every possible means and devotedly confronted the issue."
choice_data_list: Was it you who wished for it so earnestly?
Were you the one who wished so earnestly for this?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: It must be so, without a doubt.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—For I was born into this world
as an Umamusume of the “Magnificent Clan.”

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: All of it—for the sake of the "Magnificent Clan."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The devotion she shows to her family... perhaps there is a sentiment behind it that goes beyond mere duty.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Through that, I mastered a running form optimized
for the shape of my legs, leading to where I am today.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: The doctor also told me that my body is now capable of withstanding intense races.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: However, there is always the off chance.
choice_data_list: So the reason you want to focus on training is...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
It's to get my body in peak condition
until I am confident there is no problem.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Because the place where I must fulfill my mission has already been decided.
choice_data_list: The Triple Tiara route...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Delivering results on that path
is a duty of paramount importance—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Displaying our family's prestige there
and passing the torch to the next generation is my duty.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...I've talked for too long.
I'll head to the track."
choice_data_list: Wait!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: What might it be?
choice_data_list: If anything happens, come talk to me right away.
If anything happens, talk to me right away.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "I told you earlier that there's nothing wrong right now, didn't I?"
choice_data_list: Even so...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There may never be a moment she actually relies on me. Even so, reaching out... just letting her know there's someone to talk to might be of help.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I will consider it.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I have to switch gears.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(—To think that just talking about it would drag me
back into that gloom and darkness.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(Back then... when I had lost
my very reason for being——)

text_block_list.name: Young Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone's portraits... they're as beautiful as ever.
One day, I'll be standing right up there alongside them.)

text_block_list.name: Young Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(I'll achieve glorious feats in races
and become the pride of our family. And then...
right in the center, next to Mother...!)

text_block_list.name: Young Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—...Can't run?
Huh...

text_block_list.name: Young Ruby
text_block_list.text:
..................Then,
what have I been doing this all for...—

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
“—Starting today, you are to attend this facility.
Specialists in every field related to racing, along with cutting-edge technology, will support your running.”

text_block_list.name: Young Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...!
Mother, I...

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...You wish to run, do you not, Ruby?
If so, stake it on our family's pride—and run.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(――...From that day until now,
everyone has devoted so much to me.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(Yes, I must switch gears... and run.
For it is the only way I can repay this immense debt of gratitude.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I will not let the achievements of the "Splendid Clan" end with me—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Training wrapped up without incident, but toward the end, Daiichi Ruby seemed to carry an even more tense atmosphere than usual.
choice_data_list: (I wanted to call out to her, but...)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyyy~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Lady Trainer, you okay?!
Feelin' kinda down in the dumps??
choice_data_list: Helios...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Btw, my lady just turned down my dinner invite rn☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Seriously way too salty, for real!
Though gotta say, still made my heart flutter♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, no matter how many times Daiichi Ruby turns Daitaku Helios down,
he bounces right back and goes at it again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Dazzled by her earnest straightforwardness, I found myself curious and decided to ask.
choice_data_list: What's the trick to keep attacking?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: That party animal vibe!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"...Haha, that's hilarious☆
Besides, is there really any reason to quit?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's not like they hate me or anything!
Our timing's just been a bit off, that's all—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ruby's super straightforward, y'know?
That's just simply how ojousamas talk!
choice_data_list: Indeed...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, it's me we're talking about, right?
I'm the best, and totally lovable, aren't I!?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Well, it's basically "love ya" in the end!
choice_data_list: (...I could learn a thing or two from that confidence.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hesitated earlier, but this time
I'll call out to her just like I planned.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to grow as a Trainer alongside her like this.
—The Classic year is just around the corner.
